row.title: Research items must pass SPEC-GATE-1 at birth
row.body: research.file_items wrote Q-RES items without an out-of-scope or closing-probe line, so each one lowered spec_quality. Item writers now emit both lines; the freeadapt test checks its items with specgate.missing.
